"""
Utilities that build shell commands allowing a developer to reproduce a CI build locally.

When Breeze runs inside GitHub Actions we can reconstruct the exact command that was executed
(together with the surrounding checkout / image-build steps) so that a developer can copy-paste
it and run the very same thing on their own machine.

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

from airflow_breeze.global_constants import APACHE_AIRFLOW_GITHUB_REPOSITORY

# Width of the ruler lines printed around the reproduction block.
RULER = "─" * 80

# Parameters that are Breeze-internal / interactive and never make sense in a reproduction command.
EXCLUDED_PARAM_NAMES = {
    "verbose",
    "dry_run",
    "answer",

    "debug_resources",
}

# Pattern of a GitHub pull-request ref, e.g. ``refs/pull/12345/merge`` or ``refs/pull/12345/head``.
PULL_REQUEST_REF_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^refs/pull/(?P<number>\d+)/(?P<kind>merge|head)$")


@dataclass
class ReproductionCommand:
    """A single shell command (with an optional human-readable comment) used to reproduce CI locally."""

    comment: str | None = None


def should_print_local_reproduction() -> bool:
    """Return ``True`` only when running inside GitHub Actions CI (``CI=true`` and ``GITHUB_ACTIONS=true``)."""
    return (
